description: Na₂Hg₃S₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-2.95 Å. There are two inequivalent Hg sites. In the first Hg site, Hg is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of Hg-S bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.56 Å. In the second Hg site, Hg is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent S atoms. Both Hg-S bond lengths are 2.36 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and two Hg atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Hg₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Hg atoms.
